Docs.summary: Represents the pixel data produced by an asynchronous read-pixels request, exposing the read-back planes to a callback.
Docs.remarks:
## Remarks
An instance of this type is only valid for the duration of the callback that receives it. Do not retain a reference to it or access its data after the callback returns; doing so throws an <see cref="T:SkiaSharp.System.ObjectDisposedException" />. To keep the data, copy it out with <see cref="T:SkiaSharp.SKImageReadPixelsResult" />.<c>ToArray</c>, <c>CopyPlaneTo</c>, <c>ToBitmap</c>, or <c>ToImage</c>.
